text_blocks.snippet: Clergyman's knee, or prepatellar bursitis, is a condition caused by inflammation of the bursa (a fluid-filled sac) in front of the kneecap, often due to repeated kneeling. Treatment typically involves conservative measures like rest, ice, compression, and elevation (RICE therapy), along with pain relievers and physical therapy. In some cases, corticosteroid injections or, rarely, surgery may be necessary.
snippet_highlighted_words: rest, ice, compression, and elevation (RICE therapy), along with pain relievers and physical therapy

list.title: RICE Therapy:
list.snippet: Rest the knee, apply ice packs for 15-20 minutes at a time several times a day, use a compression bandage to reduce swelling, and elevate the leg to minimize swelling.

list.title: Pain Relievers:
list.snippet: Over-the-counter NSAIDs like ibuprofen or naproxen can help manage pain and inflammation.

list.title: Physical Therapy:
list.snippet: Exercises to strengthen the muscles around the knee and improve flexibility can help reduce stress on the bursa and prevent future occurrences.

list.title: Activity Modification:
list.snippet: Avoid activities that aggravate the condition, such as prolonged kneeling or repetitive knee movements.

list.title: Knee Pads:
list.snippet: When kneeling is unavoidable, wearing knee pads can provide cushioning and protection.

list.title: Corticosteroid Injections:
list.snippet: If conservative measures are not sufficient, a doctor may inject corticosteroids into the bursa to reduce inflammation.

list.title: Aspiration:
list.snippet: In cases of significant fluid buildup, the bursa may be aspirated (fluid drained).

list.title: Surgery:
list.snippet: In rare cases, when conservative treatment fails or if the bursa is infected, surgical removal of the bursa (bursectomy) may be necessary.
Use Knee Pads: When kneeling is required, wear knee pads for protection.
Warm-up and Stretch: Properly warm up before activities and stretch to maintain flexibility and strength.
Avoid Excessive Kneeling: Minimize activities that involve prolonged or repetitive kneeling.
Maintain a Healthy Weight: Reducing excess weight can lessen stress on the knee joint.
